name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Leaf.leafKey_sim_of_false_leaf
title: Leaf lemma (C1), statistical half: the false-leaf key is exactly simulatable without a trapdoor of B
statement: Over Z_q[X]/(X^N+1), with the l-succinct LWE block identity B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G, a bit attribute w, A = sum_i w_i W_i + B R, attribute keys A_j = A T_W[j] with trapdoors R T_W[j] - sum_i w_i T_B[i,j] of entries <= E, and phi(w) = 0: the leaf key of [B | A_phi - G] (box rejection over famBig Bb / famBall s, binary decompositions) sampled with a gadget trapdoor Tm of B (entries <= E_T) has exactly the same law as the one sampled with R_phi = evalSim(...), which needs no trapdoor of B, provided s + k N errBound(k N, E, phi) and s + (k N)^2 E_T are at most 2^(Bb-1) - 1.
